blocks.text: Bacteria apne qudrati (natural) ghar (habitat) mein raasta dhoondne aur ghoomne phirne ke liye harkat (motility) ke mukhtalif tareeqe istemal karte hain.

Flagellar movements: Aksar bacilli (rod jaise) aur spirilla (spiral jaise) bacteria flagella ki madad se chalte hain. Woh apne flagella se tairte (swim karte) hain. Jab bacteria ki poori population (aabadi) flagella ke zariye ek saath chalti hai to is harkat ko swarming kehte hain. Flagellar movement se bacteria liquid (maya) mein safar kar sakte hain. Flagellum ka counter clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ke ulat) ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai aur flagellum peeche peeche rehta hai.

Twitching ya crawling (rengna): Yeh satah (surface) par chalne ke liye hota hai. Yeh pili ke zariye hota hai: pili aas paas ki thos (solid) satah se chipak jate hain aur phir sikurte (retract hote) hain. Is tarah bacterial cell aage khinch jata hai.
Gliding (phisalna): Yeh twitching jaisa hi hai. Gliding mein bacteria ek chipchipa (slimy) madda nikalte hain jo unhen thos satah par aaraam se phisalne mein madad deta hai.
Sliding: Yeh harkat taqseem hote (divide hote) cells ke dhakke se paida hone wale phailao (expansion) ki wajah se hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch panels. Swimming: mayi (liquid) mein ek rod-shaped cell jis ke peeche flagella ka guchha hai. Swarming: cells ka group ek saath chal raha hai, har ek ke peeche flagella. Twitching: satah par cell jis ka pilus aage phaila hua hai; label Pilus retracts. Gliding: satah par cell peeche surmai (grey) nishan chhorta hai; label Slimy substance. Sliding: satah par taqseem hote cells ki qatar, ek naya cell shamil hota hai aur teer dono taraf bahar ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Bacteria mein harkat (motility) (kitab ki Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar ke do panels mayi (liquid) mein flagella se harkat hain: akela cell swimming karta hai, poori aabadi ikatthi chale to swarming. Neeche ke teen panels thos satah (surface) par hain: twitching mein pilus chipak kar sikurta (retract hota) hai aur cell ko aage kheenchta hai; gliding mein cell chipchipa madda (slime) chhorta hai; sliding mein naye bante cells ka dhakka colony ko dono taraf phailata hai.

Brownian movement: Kuch bacteria (jaise Streptococcus) jin ke paas na flagella hain na pili, woh fluid (maya) mein maujood zarraat (particles) ki be-tarteeb (random) aur be-qaboo (uncontrolled) harkat ki wajah se hilte hain. Yani yeh harkat bacterium khud nahin karta.

Axial filament se harkat: Kuch bacteria (jaise spirochaetes) mein ek badla hua (modified) flagellum hota hai. Ise axial filament kehte hain. Yeh ek sire par jura (anchored) hota hai aur periplasmic space (cell membrane aur outer membrane ke darmiyan) mein lambai ke rukh chalta hai. Yeh flagella jaise fibrils (baareek dhaagon) ke do sets se bana hai jo cell ke dono poles (siron) par jure hote hain. Yeh spirochaetes ko mudne (flexing), tairne (swimming), rengne (creeping) aur ghoomne (spinning) mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek lamba, S ki tarah mura hua spiral spirochaete cell. Ek peela axial filament cell ki poori lambai mein us ki bahar wali teh ke bilkul neeche lipta hua chalta hai. Labels: Cell wall, Axial filament.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Spirochaete mein axial filament (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peeli lehrdaar lakeer axial filament hai. Yeh ek badla hua flagellum hai jo bahar latakne ke bajaye cell ke andar, periplasmic space (cell membrane aur outer membrane ke darmiyan) mein, poore cell ke saath lipta rehta hai. Is mein fibrils ke do set hote hain jo cell ke dono siron (poles) se jure hote hain. Jab yeh ghoomta hai to spirochaete mudta, tairta aur ghoomta hai.

blocks.prompt: Twitching aur gliding mein kya farq hai, aur Brownian movement se bacterium ke appendages (bahar nikle hisson) ke bare mein kya pata chalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Twitching mein pili satah se chipak kar sikurte hain aur cell ko aage kheenchte hain; gliding mein bacterium chipchipa slime nikalta hai aur us par phisalta hai. Brownian movement bacterium khud nahin karta: yeh un bacteria mein hoti hai jin ke paas flagella ya pili nahin hote, aur fluid ke zarraat unhen hilate hain.

items: Flagellar movement: liquid mein tairna; poori population ek saath chale to swarming; counter clockwise ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai.
Twitching pili se (chipakna aur sikurna); gliding slime se; sliding divide hote cells ke dhakke se.
Brownian movement un bacteria mein jin ke paas flagella ya pili nahin (jaise Streptococcus); fluid ke zarraat hilate hain.
Spirochaetes axial filament se chalte hain: periplasmic space mein modified flagellum, mudne, tairne, rengne aur ghoomne ke liye.
